full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Abdul Wahhab Miah, J.:- This Civil Petition for Leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment and order dated the 16th day of March. 2011 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in First Miscellaneous Appeal No.261 of 2002 dismissing the same. 

 4. The trial Court by the judgment and decree dated 08.04.2001 decreed the suit. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree of the trial Court, the defendant filed Title Appeal No.49 of 2001 in the Court of District Judge, Chandpur. The appeal was filed by paying deficit Court fee and 30.10.2001 was fixed for supplying the deficit Court fee, on that date on the application of the appellant time was allowed up to 18.11.2001 to pay the deficit Court fee and again on 18.11.2001 the next date was fixed on 28.11.2001. And on this date the appellant did not take any step in the appeal and the same was dismissed for default. Thereafter, the defendant-appellant filed an application under Order XLI, rule 19 of the Code of Civil Procedure for re-admission of the appeal along with an application under section 5 of the limitation Act for condoning the delay in filing application out of time. The application was registered as Miscellaneous Case No.8 of 2002. The miscellaneous case was dismissed on 20.10.2010. Against the said order of dismissal of the miscellaneous case, the defendant-petitioner filed Miscellaneous Appeal No.261 of 2002 before the High Court Division. The appeal came up for hearing before a single bench of the High Court Division and the same was dismissed; hence this petition for leave to appeal. 

 6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the nature of the suit, we are of the view that justice would be best served, if the appeal (Title Appeal No.49 of 2001) is restored to its original file and number with a cost of taka. 50,000.00 to the plaintiff-respondent No.1 to be paid by the petitioners.
